name: transmission
operation: holding acquired from another observer's output rather than from own contact with the referent
valid_on: source had residual contact with the referent
referent has not moved faster than the chain's transit time
chain depth is bounded and known
breaks_when: chain depth unknown — no way to bound accumulated O
referent changes faster than transmission latency (stale on arrival, arrives looking fresh)
source's station occludes the same axis as receiver's (correlated error reads as independent confirmation)
circulation mistaken for confirmation — N restatements of one source counted as N sources
receipts unrecoverable in fact, not just absent in transit — then it is a01, reclassify

sub_modes.t1_direct: one hop from a residual observer. depth 1.
sub_modes.t2_chained: multiple hops. O accumulates per hop, unlogged.
sub_modes.t3_institutional: passed through a review filter. filter has its own O (register, fundability, publishability) applied as selection, not as content.
sub_modes.t4_formation: acquired pre-verbally / during training. depth unknown, source unrecoverable, and it is the layer that does the reading rather than a holding that gets read.

uptake_maintained_by: keeping the chain logged as the holding travels — recoverability survives only while the path back is written down at each hop
uptake_decays_when: no hop records the path, at which point recoverability degrades from in_principle to none and the holding has become a01 whether or not anyone reclassifies it

provenance.note: id, name, channel, operation, carries, cost, lands_on, receipt_recoverable, valid_on, breaks_when, sub_modes and status are the author's text, quoted verbatim from the tier spec. uptake_maintained_by and uptake_decays_when were written during the build to satisfy the unfalsifiable-availability check the same spec defines
